correctness.rationale: The binomial identity and Kummer/Lucas reduction prove pointwise residues for all n. Exact eight-state transitions give uniformly distributed triple states by the checked annihilating polynomial and simple dominant eigenvalue. Aligned dyadic blocks from any prefix inherit the matrix bound, proving ordinary density and O(sqrt N) errors. The proved cubic recurrence for the special dyadic count gives the sharp infinite family. Exact arithmetic checker independently replays the critical matrix and initial values, and finite enumeration checks the proposed word census.

value.rationale: The exact complete distribution of four successive Apéry residues is a natural number-theoretic correlation: eight of 32 parity-compatible quadruples are forbidden, 24 have two distinct rational frequencies, and the optimal square-root discrepancy has an infinite explicit witness. These are quantitatively informative beyond the classical pointwise congruence or its automaton representation; no paper-sized theorem is required.
